why: Three campaign names were turned away on 2026-09-14 and five more on 2026-10-05 because each is the start of a real, maintained package (sass-format and sass-formatter), and a fixed-string match would report every project using the real one as infected. A dependency is its whole name. A project depending on a longer package that merely begins with a campaign name depends on something else, and saying INFECTED to it is the false positive this repository ranks worst.

findings.match: no known-bad package names in manifests
